text: Judgment call: servant or slave. The Hebrew word covers both; servant is the traditional English word and fits court officials, slave fits only bondage. If you pick servant, the quality session can flag uses where bondage is clear.
Judgment call: sar is used for ranks from officers to princes. Chief is neutral. Check the word sheet if you want to split it into official and commander senses.
Held for the Genesis 1 to 5 test. Man with the article, mankind for the race and Adam as a personal name may need separate senses. Approve only if you want to settle it later.
